name: 1280 Seymour St (rezoned as 575 Drake St), as built per public record: 10 storeys, 40 shelter units for youth 16 to 24
proponent: Covenant House Vancouver (public record: rezoning applicant)
rezoning_path: DD to CD-1 (701), public hearing 24 Jan 2017
notes: Simulated user test, 23 Nov 2026. PUBLIC RECORD: 10 storeys; 40 shelter units, most with two beds, expandable to 80 spaces; CMHC National Housing Co-Investment Fund about $7.8M, BC Housing grant about $2.5M and about $475,000 a year operating, about $23.66M from donations (news.gov.bc.ca, 17 Jun 2022). FSR 5.15, height 36 m, 75 shelter beds, 4 parking spaces at rezoning (public hearing deck, 24 Jan 2017). MY ASSUMPTIONS: floor area 4,312 m2 = FSR 5.15 x the 837.3 m2 parcel the lookup found (the rezoning site area was not read); the 40 shelter units entered as 40 studios and as 40 deep-subsidy homes because the tool has no shelter bed or room type; all 40 marked supportive; land entered at $0 as already held (not a public figure); equity = the donations; other grants = $7.8M + $2.5M; zero setbacks (a downtown street wall); floor to floor 3.6 m = 36 m over 10 storeys; the two funder programs are targeted only to see what the tool says, the building was not funded by either.
